text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Twin Turbo just runs away with the lead! 
Twin Turbo simply bursts ahead!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo makes a break for it! Twin 
Turbo is running away with the lead!!

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
“—Pulling pure bullshit like that...! Who 
could possibly keep up with that 
crap...?!”

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Guh...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa――

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah, hah, hah—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: ――Oooooooohhhhhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What was that...?! She's way faster 
than when we were training together...!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Goooooooo for it!!!! Tuuuuurbooooo!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Turbo...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What an incredible person... To surpass 
her own limits at this crucial moment...! 
With this, no one will be able to...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—What a truly terrifying person you are. 
Only you... could have foreseen even 
this...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —Haah, haah, haah, haah...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Turbo-san...! You truly are amazing...! 
Running far beyond expectations and 
overwhelming everyone...!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (However—!!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaahhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Experience told me...! That you would 
deliver a performance today far beyond all 
expectations...!!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Let's do this!! Turboooo!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Across the line!!! And the winner is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa――

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa... haa――

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... Hey... Ikuno...â

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo... I wonder if I got through to 
her...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
To Teio... "This is what it means to never 
give up"--

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if... I managed to convey it to 
you... properly...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...I'm all right.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I'm sure... it must have reached them.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Turbooo!! Iknooo!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Tannhauser-san, Nature-san—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Good work, you two. She said she wants to 
talk to you.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: It's Teio, Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Teio......

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: “――――I watched your race.”

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, Turbo. To be honest... I 
underestimated you."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I assumed that your big runaway strategy 
would never work against strong 
Umamusume... I jumped to conclusions.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—Still, today, you proved you could fight 
with that runaway lead of yours.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"She amazed everyone in the venue—and me, 
too. She completely blew away the 
assumption that she wouldn't stand a 
chance...!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You really showed me... your 
'never-give-up running' style...!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
""...Thank you. For showing me the courage 
to move forward.""

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Umm—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I don't really understand... but is Teio 
coming back...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
“――――Yeah. I won't give up, I'm gonna keep 
moving forward.”

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"‘I don't know when it'll be, but... I 
promise I'll run for you again.’"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: ...! Really!? For real, for real!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "Really, truly!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Y—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: ‘WE DID IIIIIIIIIT!!!!’

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Heheh—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. Could you switch me over to 
Ikuno?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: “――――Yes. What seems to be the matter?”

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "—Your run was incredible too, Ikuno."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"It's precisely because you've run so many 
races that you were able to react to 
Turbo's massive runaway lead and fight 
back—"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...Somehow, hearing that gave me courage, 
in a totally different way from Turbo."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Like, as long as we train and run, we can 
grow without limits, or something—"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"I just... felt that kind of potential in 
you, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "So to you too, Ikuno... Thank you."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"‘...I promise you. I'll come back 
stronger than ever before.’"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...I'll be eagerly looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the grand operation at the All 
Comers concluded without a hitch—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "—I'm really glad I ran the All Comers."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The experience gained from facing Ms. 
Turbo, and—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"We have realized anew... that there are 
things we can only show through our 
running."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
......And next up— it's finally time for 
the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, isn't it?
choice_data_list:
Let's start making adjustments starting 
today.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes. For the battle has already begun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Armed with irreplaceable experience, we 
began taking steps toward the Queen 
Elizabeth II Cup—the culmination of Ikuno 
Dictus's medium-distance campaign—
